title: QANAD: A Model-Driven Framework for Quantitative Analysis and Synthesis of Activity Diagrams via Probabilistic Model Checking
abstract: arXiv:2403.00169v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Probabilistic model checking is a widely used formal verification technique to automatically verify qualitative and quantitative QoS properties for probabilistic models, such as reliability, performance, and cost. However, devising suitable and representative models for systems of interest in model checkers, writing corresponding properties, and verifying them requires domain knowledge in probabilistic models, formal verification, and the target model checkers. This unavoidably makes model checking not easily accessible for researchers and engineers who may lack the required knowledge. Previous work has extended UML activity diagrams with probability and time, along with quality annotations, developed transformations from activity diagrams to probabilistic models which model checkers support, and implemented accompanying tools for automation. translated_title: QANAD：基于概率模型检测的活动图定量分析与综合的模型驱动框架
translated_abstract: 概率模型检测是一种被广泛使用的形式化验证技术，可用于自动验证概率模型的定性与定量服务质量属性，例如可靠性、性能和成本。然而，在模型检测器中为感兴趣的模型系统设计合适且具有代表性的模型、编写相应的属性并进行验证，需要具备概率模型、形式化验证以及目标模型检测器方面的领域知识。这不可避免地使得缺乏相关知识的研究人员和工程师难以使用模型检测技术。先前的工作已经通过概率、时间以及质量标注对UML活动图进行了扩展，开发了从活动图到模型检测器所支持的概率模型的转换，并实现了配套的自动化工具。然而，这些研究较为零散、非正式或未完全开源，使得其使用与扩展受到限制（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出QANAD框架，通过概率模型检测实现对UML活动图的定量分析与综合，为缺乏形式化验证领域知识的研究人员和工程师降低了使用门槛。
en_tdlr: QANAD is proposed as a model-driven framework for quantitative analysis and synthesis of activity diagrams via probabilistic model checking, lowering the barrier for researchers and engineers lacking formal verification expertise.
